subject: Glints accelerator — bridge credit qualification & top-up request
messages:
From: Aisha Gupta <aisha@glints.ai>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Cc: HatchHub Ops <ops@hatchhub.org>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick ask — cohort demo extension & bridge credits

Hi David,

Hope you’re well — we’re running into a timing issue with our HatchHub cohort demo next Friday. Due to a last-minute pivot in our integration tests, we’ll need another two weeks of sandbox capacity and trial credits so our demo is representative.

Can Redwood approve a one-time bridge top-up (additional $1,500 in credits) and extend the trial window for Glints Labs by 14 days? We’ve been a heavy trial user and intend to convert to Dedicated if the demo goes well — attaching the current usage export and the MAP draft HatchHub asked us to share.

Attached: glints_trial_usage.csv, signed-MAP-draft.pdf

Appreciate a quick eligibility check,
Aisha
Founder, Glints Labs
https://glints.ai

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Gupta <aisha@glints.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2027 09:46:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — cohort demo extension & bridge credits

Aisha — thanks for the context and the attachments. I ran a quick pass on usage and the MAP. A couple of quick checks before we can approve a top-up: 

1) Confirm the account is enrolled in our accelerator promo (I see a pending intake record).
2) Do you require the credits on the Hosted API or will you accept a sandbox-only allocation?
3) Any legal/PO constraints from HatchHub that would require a custom contract or visibility to your legal team?

If the account is confirmed eligible, we can typically grant a one-time extension + credit top-up for demo purposes. I’ll loop in Marissa for a sign-off on the amount, and Neha for finance/eligibility.

Next steps: reply with the enrollment confirmation and preferred allocation (hosted vs sandbox). I’ll try to get a decision by EOD tomorrow.

— David
David Kim
Account Executive, Platform Growth
Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — cohort demo extension & bridge credits

Forwarding David — I reviewed the usage CSV and the MAP stub. High-level thoughts:

- Usage looks modest but concentrated on embeddings and short chat sessions — good candidate for a small, managed top-up.
- Approve up to $1,500 in trial credits (hosted API) for a 14-day extension, provided we get the HatchHub acknowledgement and the account completes enrollment (marketing intake).
- Require a simple addendum (email confirmation acceptable) that credits are one-time, non-refundable, and applied to GL-2027-09-bridge-01.

I'll hold the approval until Neha confirms financial provisioning and legal is OK with the MAP draft.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Growth Programs
Redwood Inference

All — financial provisioning confirmed. We can apply a one-time hosted credit top-up of $1,500 to Glints Labs (deal GL-2027-09-bridge-01) and extend the trial window by 14 days. Requirements: 

- Send an email addendum from Glints (Aisha) acknowledging one-time, non-refundable nature of credits and intended demo use.
- Attach the HatchHub enrollment confirmation to the account record.
- Ops will provision credits within 2 business hours of receiving the addendum.

Rishi — please coordinate the actual credit application and mark the HubSpot deal as "Promo Applied".

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
